verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local inference runtime, so CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any x86 SIMD optimization. The only CPU-related item is a log line about falling back to CPU when no ROCm library is found, and community notes that Ollama builds on llama.cpp say nothing about Ollama's own instruction-set support.
